attribution.note: Zitron directly states and endorses the assessment of Nebius's progress.

semantics.note: The proposition faithfully captures the negative assessment of the identified project. The construction start date supplies background, and the shareholder letter supplies the stated basis.

contract.note: Substantial delays or construction problems are a fair plain reading in context. Using the cited letter's reporting quarter is reasonable. The contract properly distinguishes customer delivery from campus construction and does not assume all 300MW was due.

evidence.note: Management reports an on-time first customer tranche during the target quarter, weighing against poor execution. This company disclosure does not establish overall construction performance; expectations for remaining deliveries are not outcomes.

The company filing corroborates a November delivery, providing limited counterevidence to poor progress. It supplies neither a comparable planned milestone nor the tranche's construction scope. The February delivery is outside the target period.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes a reported on-time customer tranche but lacks comparable planned and achieved construction milestones. It neither establishes substantial project problems nor sufficiently demonstrates that the overall build-out was on schedule. The initial opening expectations and later delivery schedule remain unreconciled.
